answer_1.quote: This paper provides a general framework to carry out error analyses... We focus on text errors, which we define as countable instances of things that went wrong, as identified from the generated text.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of information visualisations (i.e., charts), explanations of plumitifs (dockets), simplified Japanese sentence-ending predicates, French and English question-answering outputs

answer_2.quote: examples to analyze may also be selected based on quantitative values: automatic metric scores or ratings in a preceding general human evaluation.

answer_4.quote: They conducted a human evaluation study, asking 20 native speakers to indicate the presence of errors in the outputs of a French and English system.
answer_4.guideline: asking 20 native speakers to indicate the presence of errors in the outputs
